benchmark_info.title: 20-Molecule Experimental 1H and 13C NMR Chemical Shift Prediction Benchmark

magnet.title: MagNET
magnet.geometry: RDKit ETKDG (10 conformers, seed=7) + MMFF94 lowest-energy conformer

metric_definitions.exchangeable_proton_policy: All OH, NH, and SH protons (H bonded to O, N, or S) are excluded on both predicted and experimental sides.
metric_definitions.assigned_topological_group: Primary metric. V2000 explicit-H molblock atoms are aligned to Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(canonical)) via chiral graph isomorphism and grouped by 2D topological symmetry classes (Chem.CanonicalRankAtoms(..., breakTies=False)). Diastereotopic CH2 / gem-dimethyl experimental shifts within a topological class are averaged, and degenerate fast-exchange keto-enol tautomer symmetry is explicitly applied on #05 Curcumin (merging 21 static enol 13C / 13 1H classes into 11 dynamic 13C / 7 1H classes).
metric_definitions.hungarian_group_tautomer_aware: Same 1-to-1 group Hungarian matching after folding #05 Curcumin's degenerate keto-enol tautomer pairs.

nmrshiftdb2_experimental_spectra_jsonl.note: All 20 benchmark entries originate from nmrshiftdb2 raw-data assigned records.

metadata_and_chemical_notes: #15 Lawsone (mol_id 20143612): NMReDATA record metadata lists freq_1H = 100.568 MHz (copied from 13C), whereas raw Bruker acqus $SFO1 in 40256222.zip is 399.9548 MHz.
#13 4-(2,2,2-Trifluoroethoxy)aniline (mol_id 60004996): metadata lists freq_13C = 100.0 MHz, whereas raw Bruker acqus $SFO1 in 60004161.zip is 150.9355 MHz (paired with 600.2028 MHz 1H).

#05 Curcumin (mol_id 10027206): exists as a rapidly equilibrating degenerate keto-enol tautomer in DMSO-d6 (11 13C and 7 1H C-H signals). Static DFT-trained MagNET predicts distinct C=O (193.25 ppm) and =C-OH (166.98 ppm) shifts whose 50:50 tautomer average (180.12 ppm) matches experiment (183.06 ppm).

#08 (mol_id 60001975): verified by OPSIN/RDKit as tert-butyl 2,4,4a,6-tetrahydro-5H-[1,3]dioxolo[4,5-g]pyrano[3,4-c]isoquinoline-5-carboxylate (IK14=OYMHZDJEHYRCLB); triplicate NMReDATA t-Bu peak rows deduplicated.

#10 (mol_id 20062583, C17H21NO3, IK14=ASUTZQLVASHGKV) is Galanthamine (not codeine); #11 (mol_id 20192008, C16H12O5, IK14=MLWIYODOURBGPI) is Brazilein (oxidized quinonoid form, not brazilin); #17 (mol_id 40265338, C21H30O2, IK14=CYQFCXCEBYINGO) is (-)-trans-Delta9-THC / dronabinol (not Delta8-THC).
